previousIssues.issue: w7a/w7b (high in B, medium in A): Type A door lining mirrored fore-aft
previousIssues.status: fixed for the lining furniture. In m18 (yaw +pi/2, so screen right = forward) the arming-indicator box is now upper LEFT (aft), the handle housing and grip sit left of the arc centre, and the crimson arc sweeps aft to forward with its arrowhead pointing down on the RIGHT (forward). That matches lalf_133 (arming box x~620/1500 upper left, arrowhead x~740 right, window x~790 right). m17 (L3) shows the same arrangement. The viewing window is still hidden under the housing; that belongs to the shell (07_shell.js, hand-off to c-0.28) and is not scored here.

previousIssues.issue: w7a/w7b medium: welcome galley glass door has no pane or frame
previousIssues.status: partly fixed, with a partial regression. There are now charcoal stiles, a round boss on the forward stile and a pane. But the pane is an opaque quad (#5d5b56, rendering #2a2a28-#2c2c29 in m03), so the shelves and boxes that were visible in w7 have disappeared. What remains is three dark lines and a solid diagonal 'sheen' bar that reads as a plank lying across the door. In omaat_room_32 the pane samples #4d4c4a-#514d4c and the contents (papers, boxes) show clearly through it.

issues.detail: Welcome galley pane is opaque; contents gone
issues.problem: The w7a/b fix replaced the see-through shelves with an opaque grey quad. The cabinet now reads as a solid dark door with a diagonal grey plank across it, not as smoked glass. The real door shows its shelves, papers and boxes through a darker pane, plus a soft vertical reflection band near the hinge side.
issues.evidence: omaat_room_32.jpg: pane #4d4c4a at (800,600), contents clearly visible (x 760-900, y 200-700). w8/m03_welcome.png: pane #2a2a28 at (620,350), with a diagonal bar at x 555-590. w8/m16 is the same.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley (10_mono.js ~l.331-334), delete the opaque gQuad(0.34, 0.70) '#5d5b56' and the three shadow-line quads. Keep the shelves/boxes (l.325-328), but darken their colours by ~35 % to simulate the smoked glass (e.g. interior '#5a5450' -> '#3d3936', boxes x0.65). Then add a very thin pane as two narrow vertical sheen strips (gQuad(0.04, 0.66) at gc+0.12 and gc+0.15, '#6f6d67', r 0.05, m 0.3) with no rotation, instead of the tilted 0.1-rad bar. If the engine supports alpha on MAT.glass-like materials, use a full gQuad with that glass material instead.

issues.problem: The upper-unit body still renders #322f2a, against #514d4c-#605b4e in the photo (about 1.6x lighter). The reveals between the oven, screen and glass bays don't read.
issues.fix: Raise MONMAT.welcomeChar and the upper-body material in buildWelcomeGalley to about '#4c4844', and add 3 mm '#1c1b19' reveal strips between the bays.

issues.detail: Welcome tag blank; caution panel and brewer
issues.problem: The cream tag has no pictogram or text strip. The black caution text panel on the glass door's top rail is missing. The brewer is still a plain grey box with a green dot; the real one is a chrome machine with a round jug and a drip plate.
issues.evidence: omaat_room_32 (tag x 760-905, y 70-125 with pictogram on the left; black caution panel x 775-900, y 140-185; brewer x 385-470, y 450-610). w8/m03 (535-635, 105-130), brewer (80-165, 345-440).
issues.fix: l.337: add a small dark pictogram quad (0.04 x 0.04, '#5a5650') at the tag's left end and a grey text strip. Add gQuad(0.22, 0.09) '#1a1a1a' with atlas text (or two pale lines) on the top rail at y ~1.80. Brewer (l.318-319): replace the gRBox with a gCyl jug (r 0.05, MONMAT.steel, low roughness) under a black head box, on a drip-plate gBox.

issues.detail: Bar blind still a black void
issues.problem: MONMAT.blind was lightened to #3b3a3c, but the render still shows #131315-#141416, so the blind reads as a hole across a third of the unit. The material change isn't reaching the screen: the upper recess is unlit or AO-crushed.
issues.fix: In buildBar, add e: 0.03 (a faint self-lit term, as with fridgeLit) to MONMAT.blind, or move the blind forward of the black body (o + 0.066 -> o + 0.09) so it is out of the AO pocket. Brighten the slat lines from blackGloss to '#55524e' so the slats read. Also flag the AO for the lighting owner.

issues.problem: The hue is fixed, but the left F-front curtain still hangs as a free column in the middle of the passage (q01, m02), with open gaps on both sides. Real: either drawn fully across (left aisle, omaatF_40 x 0-160) or bunched against the wall edge (right aisle x 630-750).
issues.evidence: w8/q01_door1.png (drape x 395-530 of the 385-635 passage); omaatF_ANA-First-Class-Suite-777-40.jpg.
issues.fix: 05_layout.js:312 (layout amendment): set xg to the wall-side end (a < 0 ? a + 0.13 : b - 0.13) so the drape gathers against the outboard jamb, or make the left one fully drawn (xg = b) to match omaatF_40.

issues.detail: Missing EXIT sign on the door upper lining
issues.problem: lalf_133 shows a cream '非常口 EXIT' sign on the lining above the door, centred over the slide bustle. In m18 and m17 the area above the bustle is blank; only the small jamb placard exists.
issues.fix: In the door-lining loop of buildMonuments (~l.838), add gQuad(0.30, 0.06) with the atlas 'lav'/exit sign region at y ~ door top - 0.05, centred at c, inset 0.01 from the lining face, in MAT.exitGlow (or a non-glowing cream plate with red text).

issues.detail: 2R deck stub, m04 seam, ebony grain
issues.problem: These carry over from w7. The black deck slab still lies on the ash base next to the 2R jump seat (m13). The faint vertical seam in the lower middle ash flap remains (m04). The door-1 ebony walls in q01 still show long harsh horizontal streaks, not the fine grain with reddish streaks in the photos.
issues.fix: buildGalley with jumpX: give the remaining deck segment the alu nosing and end cap, or lower it flush. buildAshWall: merge the two lower-middle flap boxes. fWood: lower the LAYER contrast and shorten the streak length.
